data.title: Iran likely to spend unfrozen funds on rebuilding war capabilities, ISW warns | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Though Trump denied reports of a $300 billion fund slated for Iran, ISW noted that Iranian officials have already promised that funds set to be released as part of the deal would be used to rebuild.
